facts.fact: Mark 死于并发症，时间是 1984 年 6 月 5 日 11:42 p.m.，地点 Bellevue 医院。
是 Patrick 在 Mark 喘不上气的那晚送他进急诊，且没有通知叙述者；她次日早上才接到电话，此时 Mark 已死十一小时。
facts.anchor: But instead, Patrick took Mark to the ER one night when Mark couldn’t breathe.

facts.fact: Mark 母亲两天后在留言机留话：葬礼礼拜在布鲁克林的 Norwegian Seamen's Church 举行。
facts.anchor: There would be a service at the Norwegian Seamen’s Church in Brooklyn

facts.fact: 叙述者有十年见鬼经验；鬼多数时候只求被承认、被点头致意。
facts.anchor: most of the time they just wanted to be acknowledged, a nod on their way to who knows.

facts.fact: 死前几周 Mark 夜里都待在 Patrick 那里；他与叙述者同住十年。
facts.anchor: for the past few weeks, he had been spending his nights at Patrick’s.

facts.fact: 叙述者已故的母亲（成瘾者）会泡盐浴并解释盐能吸走负面能量。
facts.anchor: Salt, she’d explain, sucks up negativity—you could leave piles of salt in the corners of a bad-vibed room.

facts.fact: 大学毕业那年夏天在墨西哥，叙述者想教 Mark 看烛焰识鬼；Mark 叫她 Artie，并以兰波式的红 i 自嘲学不会。
facts.anchor: Sure, Artie, i’s the color red, whatever you say.

facts.fact: 葬礼前夜泡澡时窗户突然敞开，出现的是四月惨死的 François：眼球浑浊、牙龈流血、癫痫般发作并尖叫，消失后声音还在。
facts.anchor: it was François, who’d had a hard death in April.
